chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn ʿAwwāḍ, from ʿAbd al-Khāliq, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a previously married woman who seeks marriage for herself.
He said: “She has greater authority over herself. She may entrust her affair to whomever she wishes, if he is a suitable match, after she has previously married a husband before that.”

key_terms.أَمْلَكُ بِنَفْسِهَا: having stronger authority over her own person and decision
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.تُوَلِّي أَمْرَهَا: she entrusts or assigns her affair
key_terms.كُفْوًا: a suitable match or compatible spouse

ai.seo_question: Does a previously married woman have authority to arrange her own marriage in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a previously married woman in marriage. It states that she has authority over her own marital decision and may appoint whom she wishes in her affair, provided the prospective husband is a suitable match and she had been married before.
